Summaries.eng: Nai searches for someone important to him, with only an abandoned bracelet as a clue. Gareki steals and pick-pockets to get by from day to day. The two meet in a strange mansion where they are set-up, and soon become wanted criminals by military security operatives. When Nai and Gareki find themselves desperate in a hopeless predicament, they encounter none other than the country's most powerful defense organization - "Circus"!!
Summaries.jpn: 自分の名前と“嘉禄（カロク）”のことしか知らない不思議な少年、无（ナイ）。嘉禄のものであるという「輪（サーカス）」の腕輪を手掛かりに、嘉禄を捜していた无は、旅の途中で花礫（ガレキ）という少年に助けられる。

Titles.jpn: コミックスカバー裏コメント＜花礫＞

Summaries.eng: Sheltered Nai is on a journey in search of Karoku, a man who abruptly disappeared from his life. All he has to go on is Karoku's bracelet, a form of ID for members of Circus - a government agency made up of men and women with supernatural powers.
Summaries.jpn: 腕輪（ブレス）を残して居なくなってしまった嘉禄を捜していた无（ナイ）は、カラスナの領主ミネに捕らえられていたところを屋敷に侵入した花礫（ガレキ）に助けられる。

Titles.jpn: フォーチュンキャット

Summaries.eng: Now that Nai knows Karoku's bracelet has something to do with Circus, he goes in search of answers, but he finds that his earlier brush with trouble is far from over.
Summaries.jpn: トージの街で一時的に休息する无と花礫。空腹で倒れる无のために、食料を調達しに行った花礫が戻ると无の姿がなかった。

Summaries.eng: While under Circus's protection, a curious fact comes to light regarding Nai's true identity. With that clue in hand, Nai, Gareki, and several members of Circus pay a visit to where they believe Nai came from.
Summaries.jpn: 意識を失い倒れた无。心配する與儀やツクモらに、「輪」研案塔の医師・療師が衝撃の診断結果を伝える。そして花礫は无の語る“嘉禄”の言動に違和感をおぼえる。

Summaries.eng: After their trip to Rainbow Forest, Gareki asks to drop by Karasuna, where they run into an old acquaintance of his. From this enounter, Nai and Yogi learn more about Gareki's past.
Summaries.jpn: ニジの森で、ノウリョクタイに襲われる无や花礫たちの前に、貳號艇闘員イヴァが現れる。能力?を退けた一同は、嘉禄の残したあるモノを持ち帰る。

Summaries.eng: Yotaka has become a Varuga and Yogi fights him, telling Gareki and Nai to get back to Karasuna on their own. But Gareki feels very conflicted about his past with Yotaka and Tsubame, and what has happened to them now.
Summaries.jpn: 花礫と兄弟のように育った双子のツバメとヨタカ。そして姉のように、母のように自分たちを育ててくれたツバキ。彼女の死と、双子との決別。

Summaries.eng: With Yotaka gone, Gareki and Tsubame are left to pick up the pieces and make sense of what has happened.
Summaries.jpn: 迷呀を追撃する平門。逃げ惑う迷呀に容赦のない制裁を加え、「輪」の追う犯罪組織・火不火の情報を引き出そうとするが、なかなか口を割らない。

Titles.jpn: 「マーメイドの溜息」と三人の騎士

Summaries.eng: Team Two is helping Team One put on their Circus parade and show, and Yogi gets Nai and Gareki to join the parade in an effort to cheer up Gareki. But a malfunctioning Team One rabbit throws a wrench into their festivities.
Summaries.jpn: ハミの村での1件依頼、暗い様子の花礫を励ますために、與儀は无と花礫に「輪」のショーの手伝いを頼む。

Summaries.eng: Circus goes to Rinoll, the ice crystal city. Hirato sends them a warm snowman, Yukkin, which was invented in the Research Tower. Back on the ship, the Circus council discusses Nai and Gareki's circumstances, Nai being an experimental specimen. They enter a vacation house to check up on it, when leaving, Yuukin becomes trapped in a hole and is found by strangers. Nai runs off to find Yuukin, and we learn that the strangers were enemies of Circus who were trying to hide evidence left in the vacation house. Nai, Yogi, and Gareki fall into the hole, which turns out to be man made and leads to the mansion. They find a small, moving box. Yuukin travels and finds Tsukumo, unaware of the enemies close by. They confront her, but the rest of the Circus group returns after bombing the surface with one of Gareki's devices.
Summaries.jpn: 壱組の補足調査で訪れた“氷晶の街リノル”。寒さに震える中、糺（アザナ）から渡されたユッキンと、火不火（カフカ）関連屋敷を調べる无、花礫、與儀、ツクモ。

Summaries.eng: Yogi going berserk sends the bad guys running, but when Nai senses that something is wrong with him, Tsukumo turns back alone, only to run into trouble herself.
Summaries.jpn: 異様な様子の與儀を見つめる花礫。與儀の異変を感じ取りながらも、夏切と麒春に攫われるツクモを目撃する无。意識を取り戻したツクモが捕らわれた場所は…!?

Summaries.eng: With Yogi and Tsukumo out of commission, Nai and Gareki are given into the care of Airship One. The team dynamic is a little different, but the two of them still go on a mission with them, where Gareki learns more about their special powers.
Summaries.jpn: 壱號艇に一時預けられることになった无と花礫。キイチと喰に迎えられた後、早速キイチに掃除を言いつけられ…!? 一方その頃喰は花礫についてのある事実を発見する。

Titles.jpn: アイスクリームパレード

Summaries.jpn: ヴァントナームを訪れる无たち。リンダイン社総帥からの情報を受け取る平門とツクモ、ショップを見て回るという喰と別れた无と花礫はニャンペローナショップへ。

Summaries.eng: Second Ship and First Ship of Circus are off to save Karoku. They manage to take over the security system and take over the mansion, but they can't find Karoku!Karoku is shown with another person talking about Nai coming. Nai remembers his days as an animal with Karoku and reaches for the sky, where the forest opens a rainbow gate, assumedly to Karoku.
Summaries.jpn: 再び届けられた无への嘉禄のメッセージ。そしてツクモの報告と八莉から得た情報により、全てが「煙の館」へ結びつく、と判断した平門は朔と燭へ作戦を提案する。

Summaries.eng: As Nai and Gareki make their way towards the mysterious rainbow to see if Karoku is there, the rest of Circus work to wrap up what they can of the raid on the Kafka facility.
Summaries.jpn: 壱號艇と貳號艇闘員と黒白や能力者たちの戦いは苛烈さを増していく。そして目の前に現れた虹色の光の先に嘉禄が居ると感じ取った无は花礫と共に、「庭」に駆け出す。
